[NSTG.2.5.1] The default cache needs **no wiring at all** — omit the
setter and `cache` / `cached()` work against the engine's volatile
in-engine cache. Durability is opt-in: register `set_cb` and
`delete_cb` together via `ds_engine_cache_callbacks`, declared in
`runtime/include/libds.h`. On restart, the integrator seeds the engine
cache from the backing store with `ds_engine_cache_seed`, before the
engine's first stream event ([NLFC.9.1]).
